defs.def: to adjust an engine so that it runs smoothly and as well as possible 调整，调节（发动机）
to adjust the controls on a radio or television so that you can receive a particular programme or channel （给收音机、电视等）调谐，调频道
to prepare or adjust sth so that it is suitable for a particular situation 调整；使协调；使适合
